graph_title: Доля времени, затрачиваемого на неоплачиваемый труд по уходу и работу по дому, в разбивке по полу
goal_name: Goal 5: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
target_name: Target 5.4: Recognize and value unpaid care and domestic work through the provision of public services, infrastructure and social protection policies and the promotion of shared responsibility within the household and the family, as nationally appropriate
indicator_name1: Indicator 5.4.1: Proportion of time spent on unpaid domestic and care work, by sex, age and location
organization_name: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic (Department of Household Statistics)
definitions: The proportion of time spent on unpaid domestic and care work, by sex, is an indicator that reflects the number of hours per day that women and men spend on household responsibilities and caring for family members without receiving direct payment.
rationale_interpretation: Unpaid work is work performed without monetary compensation. In the context of a household, it includes caring for family members, cleaning, preparing meals and performing other household responsibilities.
data_sources: The data source is the Time Use Module of the Integrated Sample Survey of Household Budgets and Labour Force. The module is conducted once every five years and covers household members aged 12 years and older.The data source is the Time Use Module of the Integrated Sample Survey of Household Budgets and Labour Force. The module is conducted once every five years and covers household members aged 12 years and older.
data_collection: Information on the use of the daily time fund is collected by interviewing all household members aged 12 years and older who are present in the household.
computation_methods: The proportion of time spent on unpaid work, expressed as a percentage, is calculated by dividing the average amount of time spent on unpaid work per day, in minutes, by the total number of minutes in a day (1,440) and multiplying the result by 100 per cent:Proportion of time spent on unpaid work (%) = Average time spent on unpaid work per day (minutes) / 1,440 × 100
quality_assurance: The quality of the indicator is ensured through the use of a representative sample in the Integrated Sample Survey of Household Budgets and Labour Force, compliance with the established time frames and survey conditions, and multistage quality control, including checks of questionnaires for completeness and logical consistency.
data_availability_gaps: The results are available in the publications “Results of the Sample Time Use Survey” for 2010, 2015 and 2020.
disaggregation: The proportion of time spent on unpaid work is calculated by sex, age and place of residence.
